decisions.decision: User-selected Opstra reference: self-hosted Roboto; compact underline controls; square strategy diagrams; bullish/bearish/non-directional groups; dense call/put model chain. Preserve IWSM identity, blue dark mode and explicitly labelled theoretical values.

Use an expandable compact quote panel above the existing builder; preserve reference-style Roboto, green light/blue dark tokens and readable mobile controls. Actual source time and retrieval time are separate, and refresh preserves model entry positions.

Match the institute homepage: offline Inter typography, green #126744 on #f7faf8 in light mode, blue actions #1757a4 on navy #030812 in dark mode, rounded bordered panels and 8px controls. Supersedes the previous Roboto/grey/square visual treatment while preserving compact financial workflows and semantic gain/loss colors.

Owner-selected monochrome logo strip below the hero. Use locally saved original artwork, five columns on desktop and two on mobile, green light and navy dark surfaces. Restore original colours with a subtle glow on hover and keyboard focus; disable transitions for reduced motion. Sources and pending registration details are tracked in assets/featured-logos/sources.json.

Strategy Lab shows the Shree Ram Traders Lounge mark without a repeated text label. Footer IWSM artwork switches by theme, and the SEBI verification card uses a short angled green accent in light mode and blue-green in dark mode while keeping registration text on a high-contrast neutral surface.
